The embolization coils requested are proprietary to Terumo, the sole manufacturer and authorized distributor of these products. Due to clinical practice which requires surgeons to select the appropriate coil intraoperatively based on real-time findings, a full range of Terumo coils must be available on-site to support immediate patient care. Without access to these coils, procedures could be delayed, creating an unacceptable risk to patient safety and clinical outcomes.
The associated North America Classification Systems (NAICS) Code is 339112 and the Business Size Standard is 1000 employees.
THIS NOTICE OF INTENT IS NOT A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE QUOTES.  Interested parties may identify their interest and capability to respond to this requirement no later than 12:00 PM Mountain Time, Thursday, May 07, 2026.  Information received in response to this notice must clearly demonstrate the capability of meeting the Government s need as stated above.  Include any relevant information (specifications, cut sheets, brochures, capability statement, etc.) confirming the ability to supply the products and/or any services outlined in this notice. Responses to this notice are to be sent to natasha.holland@va.gov.
A determination not to compete this requirement, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government.  The Government is not responsible for any potential costs incurred from interested parties desiring to respond to this notice.
